description: This file defines various Kubernetes API types related to output information for kubeadm, including bootstrap tokens, images, upgrade plans, certificates, and expiration info.

classes.name: Images
classes.description: Represents output information for container images.

classes.name: ComponentUpgradePlan
classes.description: Contains upgrade plan details for a component.

classes.name: ComponentConfigVersionState
classes.description: Describes current and desired version states of a component config.

classes.name: AvailableUpgrade
classes.description: Represents information about a single available upgrade.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Holds information about a certificate or CA for expiration checking.

classes.name: CertificateExpirationInfo
classes.description: Provides expiration information for certificates and CAs.
